Workflow.Name: Change Radar handler: Notify-Email
Workflow.Description: Change Radar handler Notify-Email: email the spec §7 card for a queued handler run to each email: entry in alert_destinations, as the owner of the Office 365 Outlook connection (crdr_outlook), then log it. Sends only (writes = no; ADR 0011 addendum). Ships off, with its subscriptions disabled.
